## Quality evidence

Statuses are PASS, FAIL, PENDING, BLOCKED, or NOT APPLICABLE. A check that did
not run is not PASS. NOT APPLICABLE needs a reason when the check is material.
Record the commit SHA, environment, evidence, and observed result.

| Check                                 | Status | Evidence and observed result |
| ------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------- |
| Architecture / dependency change      |        |                              |
| Test strategy and regression coverage |        |                              |
| Accessibility                         |        |                              |
| Security and privacy                  |        |                              |
| Commands executed                     |        |                              |
| Release blockers                      |        |                              |
